attribution_limitations: The abstract places the VAP diagnosis "On the second day" without naming what the count starts from, while the case text places worsening oxygenation, purulent sputum and sputum culturing on postoperative day 3 and then states the diagnosis ("We therefore arrived at a diagnosis of VAP") without its own day. The two times use different or unstated anchors, so they are not two values for one time point and are not reconciled.

Source conflict on the unit of the PEEP 14 value: the Fig. 2 caption says PEEP was set at 14 mmHg, while the case text and discussion give PEEP 14 in cm H2O. The caption fact and both cm H2O PEEP 14 facts are review_only; PEEP 5 cm H2O is not disputed.

The abstract describes the surgery as reconstruction with a free musculocutaneous flap for tongue resection, while the case text describes reoperation with a free abdominal muscle flap, partial mandibular resection and tracheostomy.
Sepsis accompanying VAP and post-operative transfusion are offered only as possible explanations in the discussion and are not recorded as patient conditions or treatments.
"He is a non-smoker" is not an explicit never-smoker statement, so tobacco is recorded as absent current use rather than status never.
